title: Plans Within Plans
description: When you **enter a combat situation**, gain Prep equal to your INT (min 1). When the combat situation ends, lose all Prep. During the combat situation, you can spend 1 Prep to execute one of the following stratagems:

bullets: *Charge!* — You and willing allies rush different foes; everyone charging and being charged gets **adv** to their next dmg roll
*Coordinated Maneuver* — **Aid a PC** without a cost or risk; *what does it look like?*
*Hammer & Anvil* — Draw a foe's attention; suffer 1 dmg **piercing** and grant an ally **adv** on their next **Trade Blows** against them
*Survey* — Ask the GM a question about a foe's strengths, weaknesses, or intentions, and they will answer truthfully

title: Eye for Destruction
description: When you **set your mind to destroying something** (building, obstacle, magical artifact, etc.), treat it like **Perform a Ritual**. If this is during a combat situation, you can spend Prep, 1-for-1, to negate a requirement, except for the last one.

title: Honed Instincts
description: When you **get a bad feeling about an upcoming situation** (your call), mark a **Condition** then ask the GM how to avoid or prepare for it. Whether or not your hunch is right, the GM will give you one piece of advice; clear a Condition if you follow it.

outcomes.text: When you **go looking for someone from a past battle, friend or foe**, choose one from the following list—or two if you owe them or put them at risk (your call):
bullets: They're willing to assist you with a current conflict
They offer guidance, advice, or safety for some time
They reveal a significant secret or opportunity

title: Veteran of a Hundred Battles
description: When you **reach 0 Prep**, you may mark a **Condition** to regain 1 Prep. What past situation does this remind you of?

outcomes.text: Additionally, add the following stratagems to your **Plans Within Plans**:
bullets: Demoralize — A Bloodied foe surrenders or flees (GM's call)
First Strike — An ally acts now, even if they're surprised
Rallying Cry — A **near** ally clears a Condition
